# Sprint 1 Concept check

Use these six questions to check the ideas from the three own-your-progress activities before Test and commit. If an explanation surprises you, return to that activity and try the question again.

Answer all six questions and review the feedback. Copy your answers into a Canvas text entry. Your instructor reviews completion for 5 points; the feedback on this page does not assign a Canvas grade. Saving or copying here does not submit your work.
